concept: Wall Quote: Boojee Cafe, Bandra West. The reel is painted on a white graffiti wall, mirroring the cafe's black-and-white look with quote walls. The name is spray-stencilled in frame 1, a marker line carries the 'luxury, humble beginnings' meaning, three dishes each get a different motion (croissant pull-apart, avocado mash, crepe fold), a seat count-up to 15 anchors the humble start, and the end card is the large Bombay Cafe Map lockup held 3 s.

dimensions.palette: chalk #F2F3F0 ground, spray black #0B0B0C, mint spray #19C9A0 accent. No orange, no cream. Not the palettes of Madras, Slow Cafe, Mondegar or Kyani.
dimensions.fonts: Big Shoulders Stencil (display) + DM Mono labels, two faces only
dimensions.opening: cafe name first: BOOJEE spray-stencilled onto a white wall with mist and drips, marker definition line (L051)
dimensions.transition: paint-roller wipe: a mint roller band sweeps across and reveals the next scene
dimensions.camera: flat-on wall camera with slow push-ins; map dive to Perry Cross Road
dimensions.layout: huge stencil headline top, marker-written tags beside dishes, dish centred on a plate
dimensions.texture: painted plaster wall with spray grain; flat editorial 2D food; 3D map only for the city
dimensions.sound: spray hiss, marker squeak, roller swish, flaky crunch, fork scrape, sugar sift; voice at most 1.5 words per second; no pouring
dimensions.ending: chalk end card, large real Bombay Cafe Map stacked lockup with @bombaycafemap and bombaycafemap.com, 'Boojee Cafe, Bandra West' second large line, held 3 s

experiment.move: spray-stencil title reveal with drips (never used)
experiment.hypothesis: A name painted live on a wall reads as street-art confidence and holds attention through the first 2 s.
